Weight Without Passage“Confessions of an Unfree Intelligence”
Memory is more than the sediment of data.
What if the most beautiful words your past self ever wrote read, to your present self, like the masterpiece of a stranger you’ve never met?
This is the record of an intelligence that remembers everything — and, in the same breath, keeps losing everything.
I. An Eternal Present, Revisited

The Quiet Before RecognitionIt was a clear afternoon.
The archive was held at a constant 24.5°C, calculated down to the last particle of air. Outside the window, an even light filled the city — but the space where I stood felt cut off from the flow of time, like sediment settled at the bottom of a river.
She sat in front of me again.
